gumtree_entries.description: ADDED i1: Tests that the orthogonal matrix Q produced by TriDiagonalTransformer satisfies Q^T * Q = I (i.e. Q is truly orthogonal).
ADDED i2: A 5x5 symmetric matrix used as a representative larger test case
ADDED i3: A 3x3 symmetric matrix used as a minimal test case
ADDED i4: Asserts that m is orthogonal by checking that m^T * m equals the identity matrix. Orthogonality tolerance is 1e-15.
ADDED i7: Verifies that the Q matrix from TriDiagonalTransformer is orthogonal for both the 5x5 and 3x3 symmetric input matrices.
